project_info.color_palette: Midnight blue, cobalt blue, black, metallic silver, white

items: Top Left: Dark gradient background transitioning from near-black to cobalt blue.

Bottom Left: Large white stacked text 'Can you hear that?'.
Bottom Right: White offer line 'It's a pair of FREE Galaxy Buds3 calling.'.
Center/Background: Bold typographic composition with the earbuds case acting as the hero icon above the message.
